name: Perfecto
description_en:
Perfecto is a cloud platform for manual and automated web/mobile testing. Its overview separates test creation approaches and public/enterprise cloud workflows. The legacy perfecto.io homepage redirects to Perforce’s specifically named Perfecto page, while operating guides remain on help.perfecto.io. This establishes a document chain without merging every Perforce product into this record.

A pilot should connect a chosen device, application, test method and report. Device availability, sample-project support and administrative release permissions are different constraints. No device session, upload, automation or product account was operated in this research.
description_zh:
Perfecto 是手动及自动化 Web／移动测试云平台，概览区分编写方式及公有／企业云流程。旧 perfecto.io 首页跳到 Perforce 明确命名 Perfecto 的产品页，操作指南仍在 help.perfecto.io；这形成文档链，并不合并全部 Perforce 产品。

试点需连接选定设备、应用、测试方法及报告。设备可用性、示例项目支持及管理员释放权限是不同限制，本次未操作设备会话、上传、自动化或产品账户。

core_features.explanation_en: The manual guide covers login, device selection, app installation and report review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 手动指南涵盖登录、选设备、安装应用和查看报告。

core_features.explanation_en: The automation guide connects security tokens, target selection and generated capabilities to a test script.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自动化指南将安全 token、目标选择及生成能力接入测试脚本。

core_features.explanation_en: Releasing an in-use device requires lab-admin privileges.
core_features.explanation_zh: 释放使用中设备需要 lab-admin 权限。

en: Compare a reversible manual scenario and its Smart Reporting result on one selected device.
Validate token/capability configuration and role-scoped release in a test account.
zh: 在一个选定设备比较可逆手动场景及 Smart Reporting 结果。
在测试账户验证 token／能力配置及按角色释放。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Confirm the intended cloud/package and app-distribution path, then choose one disposable test application.
steps.zh: 确认目标云／套餐及应用分发路径，再选择可丢弃测试应用。

steps.en: Check the framework/sample scope, security-token handling and permitted device actions before automation.
steps.zh: 自动化前核对框架／示例范围、token 处理和允许的设备动作。

items.en: Free Trial cloud does not support app-store use in the reviewed overview.
items.zh: 实读概览说明 Free Trial 云不支持应用商店。

items.en: Device release requires lab-admin privileges and is not documented proof of erasure.
items.zh: 设备释放需 lab-admin 权限，且不构成文档证明的数据擦除。

pricing.summary_en: No complete current numeric price/entitlement schedule was established. The quote route and trial workflow references are not price confirmation. Pricing remains not_verified/unknown; cloud scope, device counts, concurrency, trial allocation and final contract require separate evidence.
pricing.summary_zh: 未确认完整当前数字价格／权益表，询价及试用流程引用不是价格确认。价格保持 not_verified／unknown，云范围、设备数、并发、试用额度及最终合同需单独证据。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Proposed examples were not executed.

sections.title_en: Choose the actual test and cloud scope
sections.title_zh: 选择实际测试与云范围
sections.en: The overview distinguishes BDD, scriptless and coded creation, plus mobile/web and public/enterprise cloud choices. Free Trial cloud explicitly does not support working with app stores. Verify the intended application-distribution path and selected package before reproducing a manual scenario; a general platform capability is not evidence that every trial or cloud includes it.
sections.zh: 概览区分 BDD、无脚本、代码方式，以及移动／Web、公有／企业云。Free Trial 云明确不支持应用商店，应先核对应用分发路径及套餐再复现手动场景；平台一般能力不证明所有试用或云均包含。

sections.title_zh: 核对应用到报告的路径
sections.en: The manual quick-start describes signing in, choosing a device, installing an app, exercising the scenario and reviewing Smart Reporting. Use disposable application data and a deterministic assertion. Compare the selected device and observed report before drawing a compatibility conclusion. The overview does not prove a particular device is currently free, reserved or available to an account.
sections.zh: 手动快速入门描述登录、选设备、装应用、执行场景及查看 Smart Reporting。应使用可丢弃数据和确定断言，比较所选设备与报告后再判断兼容性；概览不证明某设备当前空闲、已预约或对账户可用。

sections.title_en: A sample restriction is not a platform restriction
sections.title_zh: 示例限制不等于平台限制
sections.en: The automation guide selects framework/language, security token, device/browser, application repository and capabilities before running and reporting. It labels the referenced samples Android-only, despite the broader platform. Match the actual target and supported framework rather than extrapolating the sample to every OS or assuming it proves all platform limitations.
sections.zh: 自动化指南先选择框架／语言、安全 token、设备／浏览器、应用仓库及能力，再运行和查看报告。它明确所引示例仅支持 Android，平台范围则更广。应匹配实际目标和框架，不能将示例推广到所有 OS，也不能把它当全部平台限制。

sections.title_en: Release is privileged and does not prove data erasure
sections.title_zh: 释放属于特权操作，不证明数据擦除
sections.en: The device-release guide requires lab-admin privileges and confirmation to make an in-use device available again. It does not describe that action as verified application-data erasure. Separately,26.10 documentation describes per-user AI access and reservation visibility controls in selected enterprise clouds. Review the exact role/action/cloud scope instead of assuming every user can reclaim any device.
sections.zh: 设备释放指南要求 lab-admin 权限及确认，使使用中设备重新可用，但未将此动作描述为已验证应用数据擦除。26.10 文档另外说明逐用户 AI 访问及特定企业云预约可见性控制。应核对具体角色／动作／云范围，不能假定所有用户可回收任意设备。

sections.title_en: Keep a quote request separate from price verification
sections.title_zh: 将询价与价格核实分开
sections.en: The current commercial route is a quote request rather than a readable universal rate card. The technical overview’s Free Trial references establish a workflow category and restrictions, not its duration, quotas or a sustained-free grant. Obtain the actual cloud/device/concurrency scope and contract before treating a trial or enterprise claim as a budget.
sections.zh: 当前商业入口是询价，而非可读统一价格表。技术概览中的 Free Trial 说明流程类别与限制，不证明时长、额度或长期免费权益。应取得真实云／设备／并发范围及合同，再将试用或企业主张用于预算。
